title: SportD: How do VLMs physically strategize?
abstract: arXiv:2607.14616v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can describe a scene, but can they act well within one? We study whether VLMs can make sound strategic decisions, using soccer as an objective testbed with quantifiably-valued actions. We introduce SportD, a dataset and evaluation consisting of 1415 decision scenarios across professional men's and women's soccer games, where a VLM observes the seconds before a decision and chooses the next action. Models only select the optimal action around 30% of the time, even less frequently than humans do. Furthermore, they exhibit a clear preference for safer actions, favoring lower-variance, lower-value choices that also make less physical progress toward goal. Frontier VLMs are better at estimating whether an action will succeed, placing the highest-success-probability action among their top choices in 83-92% of cases. translated_title: 体育D：视觉语言模型如何进行物理策略？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.14616v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够描述场景，但它们能在场景中良好地行动吗？我们研究VLMs是否能做出合理的战略决策，以足球作为客观测试平台，其中动作具有可量化的价值。我们引入了SportD，一个数据集和评估体系，包含1415个来自职业男子和女子足球比赛的决策场景，其中VLM观察决策前的几秒钟并选择下一个动作。模型仅在大约30%的时间内选择最优动作，甚至比人类更不频繁。此外，它们表现出对更安全动作的明显偏好，倾向于选择低方差、低价值的选项，这些选项在朝向球门方面的物理进展也更少。前沿VLMs在估计动作是否会成功方面表现更好，在83-92%的案例中将最高成功概率的动作列为首选之一。然而，VLMs系统性地混淆了可能性与价值，将更高的价值赋予那些...
tldr: 本研究提出SportD数据集，发现视觉语言模型在足球决策中仅约30%时间选最优动作，偏好安全但低价值的选择，并系统性混淆成功概率与实际价值。
en_tdlr: This study introduces SportD, revealing that VLMs select optimal actions only ~30% of the time in soccer decisions, prefer safer low-value choices, and systematically conflate success likelihood with action value.
